open_points.subject: _normalized_origin
open_points.text: It MUST return the canonical origin: the lowercased scheme, the lowercased host, and the effective port, taking the explicit port when the value carries one and otherwise 443 for https and 80 for http.
open_points.other_text: The returned canonical origin MUST discriminate: two values differing in scheme, differing in host, differing by any additional host prefix, differing by any additional host suffix, or differing in effective port MUST each receive a different canonical origin.
open_points.question: Must scheme- or host-case-only differences normalize to the same canonical origin, or must every textual difference in scheme or host produce a different canonical origin?
